material_findings.statement: The queued workflow compiles two native C++ harnesses from the checkout used at execution time, but the prior Run-2 frozen-source drift audit enumerated only the case generator, nuisance residualizer, structural executor and workflow. The layer-capture and cvec-logit harness blob identities were not included in that frozen-source set.
material_findings.implication: A future edit to either harness before the queued self-hosted job starts could alter measurement or intervention behavior while the narrower frozen-source audit still reported its enumerated files unchanged. The exact runtime source_head must therefore be checked against the frozen blob identities of both native harnesses in addition to generator, residualizer, executor and workflow.
material_findings.current_drift_observation: No harness path appears in the dispatch-head-to-aa9607f0 compare file set, so this is a prospective provenance closure, not evidence that harness drift has already occurred.

material_findings.statement: The persisted runtime artifact is designed to include the raw holdout logits, raw downstream captures, structural case bundle and residualized layer-24 vectors. Those bytes are sufficient to re-derive per-target behavioral and downstream statistics independently of the executor's weaker aggregate PASS boolean.
material_findings.implication: Before any held-out result is observed, a separate deterministic adjudicator can prospectively freeze stricter rules: every target must show positive matched effect, negative sign-flip reversal, target-specific diagonal advantage, and dominance over matched controls; downstream target coordinates must show the same bidirectional and specificity pattern. This cannot repair missing task families or missing controls, but it prevents a pooled local PASS from being mistaken for stronger evidence.

prospective_adjudicator.data_blind_precommitment: The gate is committed while workflow 32810213066 remains queued and before its held-out runtime result is observed by this organ.
raw_artifact_binding: case-bundle canonical sha256 recomputation and exact 3x3 target x code holdout universe
strict_behavioral_rule_per_target: every matched holdout case target-code margin delta > 0
every sign-flip holdout case target-code margin delta < 0
matched mean delta exceeds the mean absolute effect of each null/orthogonal/permuted/nuisance control family
target-specific diagonal advantage over off-target semantic interventions > 0
strict_downstream_rule_per_target: matched target-coordinate mean exceeds both matched off-axis absolute mean and control target-coordinate absolute mean
prospective_adjudicator.bounded_candidate_rule: All artifact/source/runtime identity checks and all strict behavioral/downstream rules must pass, and the frozen executor itself must have emitted PASS_ABSTRACT_NATIVE_DISCRIMINATOR.

gates_this_adjudicator_deliberately_cann: Run-1 fixed-gain-32 design because the queued executor calibration-selects gain
preregistered geometric coherence and class-assignment permutation-null gate
cross-task-family abstraction beyond the single F/R/Q synthetic grammar
within-cell replication because the queued holdout has one case per target x code cell
rank-complete nuisance-subspace causal coverage when nuisance rank > 1
global workspace/J-Space coordination beyond this bounded component

counterhypotheses.statement: A positive aggregate local PASS may be driven by only a subset of semantic targets or cases.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: The prospective posthoc gate requires every target and every matched case to move in the preregistered positive direction and every sign-flip case to reverse.

counterhypotheses.statement: A future run could execute changed native measurement/intervention harness code despite the narrower frozen-source audit remaining green.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: Resolve runtime source_head in Git and require exact frozen Git blob IDs for both native harnesses plus generator, residualizer, executor and workflow.

counterhypotheses.statement: Even a strict per-target bidirectional pass within one synthetic grammar is still task-specific steering rather than global semantic J-Space.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: Not falsified by this run; the gate hard-codes the claim boundary and leaves cross-task-family, geometry, off-target, v12 and global-workspace promotion blockers explicit.
